body:
## Desired result

An application reroute should select the same effective route for a document, data request, endpoint, and client navigation.

## Acceptance

A request to an alias renders the intended route and reaches its Go load or endpoint in development and production; URL/route identity matches the pinned Kit contract.

## Current boundary

The matrix has no Go `reroute` equivalent.

Feature matrix: https://tylergannon.github.io/skgo/features.html. Kit’s pinned source and client behavior define compatibility.

**Triage — 2026-10-18**

Checked against current [`main` at `920b6aca`](https://github.com/tylergannon/skgo/tree/920b6aca738a65d6c046a67f4db2373596fafd03). Classification: `bounded-hard`. 

No Go reroute hook equivalent was found, and the current README still lists it unsupported. The acceptance endpoint is explicit across document/data/endpoint/client navigation and URL identity. This requires matching pinned Kit route resolution and coordinating browser/server identity, so it needs a larger model rather than a route-alias shortcut.

title: Support Kit reroute semantics with Go route matching
